India's LPG Imports Shift: UAE Replaces US as Top Supplier

India's Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) imports have seen a significant shift, with the United Arab Emirates (UAE) replacing the United States as the largest supplier. US supplies of LPG to India have plunged by 58%. In September, Oman emerged as the leading supplier of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) to India.
